issues.description: CSP helps prevent XSS attacks by specifying allowed content sources. Without it, your site is more vulnerable to cross-site scripting attacks.
issues.howToFix: Start with Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'. Test in report-only mode and allow the sources your application needs before enforcing it.

issues.description: HSTS ensures browsers only connect via HTTPS, protecting against protocol downgrade attacks and cookie hijacking.
issues.howToFix: After verifying HTTPS works for every route, send Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000. Add includeSubDomains only when all subdomains support HTTPS.
